title: My game console had a save file with my name 🎮
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 1:36 in the morning my game console showed a save file with my name.

scenes.narration: At 1:36 in the morning my game console showed a save file with my name.
I barely use it. The file was dated tomorrow. Time played, forty hours. Location, my flat.
I loaded it. The game was only my living room, drawn in dark polygons. My sofa. My lamp. A tiny character, standing at my window.
I moved it. My real curtain moved. I moved it again. A real floorboard creaked, exactly in time.
In the corner a quest appeared. Find the player. I looked at the character, then at the real window, where a shape stood with its back to me, holding a controller.
A message popped up. Player two has joined. And the controller in my hands buzzed, then went limp, as if someone else had taken over.
On the screen my character turned and walked toward the camera. Behind me, slowly, a floorboard counted its steps. Press start to continue, said the title. Press nothing, to be replaced.
So tell me. Do you press start, or pull the plug?
